generation.scope: For every finite point window of opposite rank eight with at least one simple local component, a middle support of dimension three certifies regularity; otherwise the two opposite pairs are simultaneously symmetrizable and the existing bisymmetric finite all-degree test is necessary and sufficient. The proof includes dependent commutators, nondiagonalizable commuting planes, and both skew alternatives.

open_mathematics: Extend rank-eight coverage to finite point schemes without a simple local factor, and analyze higher opposite ranks and positive-dimensional projection fibers; global components and specializations are still open.
